$comment: Inputs of script/dependency_scorecard.ts. Every package of package-lock.json whose source repository has an OpenSSF Scorecard below `threshold` (Dependency review's default) fails the check unless `allowances` lists it with the reason it cannot be removed; an allowance that no longer applies fails too. Scores are those of api.scorecard.dev; the list is the full-tree result of 2026-10-29 (the Markdown linter, whose micromark packages scored 2.1-2.8, was replaced by the standalone rumdl binary instead of being allowed).

allowances.@jridgewell/resolve-uri: Transitive dependency of vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8 and @stryker-mutator/core (@jridgewell/trace-mapping, source-map handling). Required by the test, coverage and mutation gates.
allowances.acorn-jsx: Transitive dependency of eslint (espree, its parser). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.character-entities: Transitive dependency of eslint-plugin-unicorn (micromark > decode-named-character-reference). unicorn has no variant without micromark, and its correctness rules are part of the lint gate.
allowances.debug: Transitive dependency of eslint (@eslint/config-array) and typescript-eslint (parser, project service). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.decode-named-character-reference: Transitive dependency of eslint-plugin-unicorn (micromark). unicorn has no variant without micromark, and its correctness rules are part of the lint gate.
allowances.deep-is: Transitive dependency of eslint (optionator, its option parser). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.des.js: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (typed-rest-client, used by its dashboard reporter, which core requires unconditionally). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.escalade: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core and eslint-plugin-unicorn (browserslist > update-browserslist-db). Required by the mutation and lint gates.
allowances.esrecurse: Transitive dependency of eslint (eslint-scope, its scope analyzer). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.estraverse: Transitive dependency of eslint (eslint-scope, esquery). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.esutils: Direct dependency of eslint. ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.fast-deep-equal: Direct dependency of eslint, and of ajv (used by eslint and @stryker-mutator/core to validate configuration). Required by the lint and mutation gates.
allowances.fast-json-stable-stringify: Transitive dependency of eslint and @stryker-mutator/core (ajv, which validates their configuration). Required by the lint and mutation gates.
allowances.flru: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (its instrumenter's @babel/core). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.gensync: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (its instrumenter's @babel/core). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.globrex: Direct dependency of eslint-plugin-n. The plugin's rules on deprecated and unsupported Node.js APIs are part of the lint gate; no other plugin provides them.
allowances.human-signals: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (execa, used to run the test runner). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.import-meta-resolve: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (its instrumenter's @babel/core). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.imurmurhash: Direct dependency of eslint (its result cache). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.js-md4: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (typed-rest-client, used by its dashboard reporter, which core requires unconditionally). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.js-tokens: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (its instrumenter's @babel/core > @babel/code-frame) and @vitest/coverage-v8. Required by the mutation and coverage gates.
allowances.jsesc: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (@babel/generator) and eslint-plugin-unicorn (regjsparser). Required by the mutation and lint gates.
allowances.json-stable-stringify-without-jsonify: Direct dependency of eslint. ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.levn: Transitive dependency of eslint (optionator, @eslint/plugin-kit). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.minimalistic-assert: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (des.js of typed-rest-client, used by its dashboard reporter). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.optionator: Direct dependency of eslint (its command-line parser). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.prelude-ls: Transitive dependency of eslint (levn, optionator, type-check). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.progress: Direct dependency of @stryker-mutator/core. Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.require-from-string: Transitive dependency of @stryker-mutator/core (ajv, which validates its configuration). Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.spdx-exceptions: Transitive dependency of eslint-plugin-jsdoc (spdx-expression-parse, used by its check-values rule). The plugin is the documentation-coverage gate.
allowances.spdx-expression-parse: Direct dependency of eslint-plugin-jsdoc (its check-values rule). The plugin is the documentation-coverage gate.
allowances.spdx-license-ids: Transitive dependency of eslint-plugin-jsdoc (spdx-expression-parse, used by its check-values rule). The plugin is the documentation-coverage gate.
allowances.tree-kill: Direct dependency of @stryker-mutator/core. Stryker is the only mutation tester with a Vitest runner, and mutation testing is a required gate.
allowances.tunnel: Runtime dependency of the action: @actions/http-client, used by @actions/core and @actions/github (both mandated by ECS-REQ-003 and bundled in dist/), depends on it for proxy support. Also used by @stryker-mutator/core (typed-rest-client).
allowances.type-check: Transitive dependency of eslint (levn, optionator). ESLint is the lint gate and has no alternative core.
allowances.uri-js: Transitive dependency of eslint and @stryker-mutator/core (ajv, which validates their configuration). Required by the lint and mutation gates.
